dataGroups.name: reference-data
dataGroups.description: The public reference reads — the world summary and the country list (ADR-0007, §11.4). They change only when the world is seeded or a tier is generated, so the network is still preferred but the last answer is kept for reading offline.

dataGroups.name: match-presentations
dataGroups.description: Recently viewed match replays. A published presentation is immutable, so the network is preferred but the last answer is kept for reading offline (ADR-0007, §11.4).
